text:
joanne: Quick sync - BetaCorp POC blocked. Their IdP sends mixed NameID (sometimes email, sometimes persistent) and SCIM group resources have "members": null. They need Dedicated pool capacity by EOW for load tests. Can we triage?
felix: Mixed NameID is rough. Do we have a fallback mapping? We normally map persistent->internal id, email->user lookup. Need examples.
joanne: Snippet from them (sanitized):
```xml
<NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent">XyZ-789</NameID>
```
and sometimes:<NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:emailAddress">sam@betacorp.com</NameID>

ria: SCIM sample they sent:
```json
{"Resources":[{"displayName":"platform","members":null,"roles":["dev"]}]}
```
So groups exist but members null. Probably they disabled full group sync.
infra-oncall: Dedicated ETA: we can reserve a 6-GPU pool in 3 business days after ticket. If they need sooner we can do hosted concurrency bump for 48-72h while networking is arranged. Private/VPC deploy is 2+ weeks.
sec-bot: Policy: temporary Hosted API keys allowed with TTL <=72h, scoped rights, and logged. For SSO: prod requires stable identifier (email or persistent) and MFA enabled. We'll annotate the security questionnaire.
felix: Short-term options: 1) issue temp API key scoped to POC (recommended), 2) implement a tolerant mapping in our connector that accepts persistent or email and tries both lookups (quick patch), 3) ask IdP to enable group member syncing.
joanne: Customer asked if we can accept roles field as proxy for membership for POC. Is that OK?
ria: We can map roles->group membership only if roles contain explicit user references. If roles are just role names, that won't help. Ask for a sample of users referenced in roles.
deploy-bot: [notice] Temp API key created: poc-betacorp-48h (expires in 48h). Owner: joanne.
joanne: I'll send them the temp key and request: 1) raw SAML assertion with both NameID cases, 2) SCIM full payloads and settings screenshot, 3) firewall egress rules for SCIM. I'll also open the Dedicated ticket. Posting updates here when I have them. :thumbsup:
